name: Saptak Chem & Business Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, Saptak Chem and Business Ltd does trading of Chemical and Agriculture Produce[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company manufactures, imports, exports and deals in organic and inorganic chemicals, intermediate derivatives and byproducts including silicates, caustic soda, soda ash, Phosphoric Acid, Hydrochloric Acid, Sulphuric Acid, Nitric Acid etc. ether, ethyl chloride, plastics, resins, dye-stuffs, food-direct colours, basic and rapid fast colours, pigments, products derived from phosphate mines, lime stone quarries, bauxite mines and other natural deposits useful or suitable in the manufacturing of chemicals and chemical products

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -3.73%
